title: looking to play browser based Ai Developed (partial or entirely is fine) games
author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
selftext:
I am looking to try out as many browser based no download games as I can find to see which ones we should add to our gaming website

  
drop your links in the comments and Ill reply with a sentence or two of initial impressions and feedback :)

comments.author: Afraid-Act424
comments.body: [https://spascii.com/](https://spascii.com/)

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
Super nice! I love the ascii aesthetic 

The smoothness of the flight animations are super satisfying.  the rumble was great

comments.author: MightyBig-Dev
comments.body: I’ve got just the thing. My new game [Nelly Jellies](http://nellyjellies.com). Designed for phone but works fine on desktop too.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: went ahead and tested on mobile to give the most accurate perception.  love the main menu and  the subtle floats, keeps the engagement from the otherwise static. Love the small ripples in the coastline. superb  5 seconds in and Im already seeing this as a go to airport game . Love these merge em games too, one of my favorites from the new genre of games. runs smooth as well, has enough UI and good onboard hints and modals not obstructive

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: Glad you like it!  I’ve got a massive community event coming out on Friday. All players will contribute to 1 goal to unlock a new mode 💜🐙

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: Oh this is fun, will it send native notifications for iOS users to remind them? Would seriously download on my ipad just to support and its fun

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: I haven’t implemented native notifications quite yet but I will. It’s available for iOS and Android and I’d appreciate a download and review if you love it 🥰

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: would love to add it to our gaming website so others can find it and play it & hopefully then download the app!

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: Lmao there’s I think 8 or 9 rare jellies with unique abilities. I have a huge notepad full of new ones to add, I’m going to slowly release them to keep the game interesting. Thanks for checking it out 🪄😘

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body: top marks, It's not overly complicated and doesnt try to reinvent the game its trying to be while at the same time being a very good version of the type of game it is. If this was on those ads they show you when youre using other apps where you get the 5 seconds or 30 moves demo before being auto redirected to a download page, you'd be getting the download like 7/10 times I'm sure of it. Game has appeal

replies.author: MightyBig-Dev
replies.body: That interesting feedback that you think it had strong ad ctr. I don’t have the money to run them but it’s good to know if it grows to a point where I can afford it. I’m kinda banking on social/share/reddit/organic at the moment. I have about 5k players a month total but only about 1000 of them are on native apps where the monetization lives.

replies.author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
replies.body:
I think its not bad, it is text heavy and some of it gets lost with the more importance colored ones or vice versa. I did think those onboarding modals were helpful def because there are quite a few things to do. I did like the delves all the way up to the combat point seeing that claude game space lol but I get its in progress. I would suggest doing small pixel art characters for each hero and then a small environment and then have them ported there. Combat log is fun to watch though , should have the option to slow it down a bit so can review in real time almost although I know some like to skip through 

  
same for logo and guild crests, I think all this game needs is a nice polish of some more custom personality and art and you've got a in depth textrpg here

replies.author: bretticuseightytwo

Excellent point regarding combat and art., I'll look into that and see what I can do 

Thank you so much for the feedback and giving it a shot it's much appreciated!

replies.author: MKopelke

Thanks for the kind words! Still a long way to go!

I do intend to eventually put multiplayer into the game, but right now after an initial burst of excited Codex work to make the first level, I've now realised the entire project is not structured properly, so am spending a week or so fixing the engine and architecture so going forward it's easier for me to drop new levels and features into the game.

Hey brother, I tried them all. I gotta say my favorite and you probably couldve guessed were spree and kick brawl. The graphics for kick were really nice I like the pixel characters they looked like ones from 8 bit games like habbo hotel. Spree was a nice concept too and the shopping carted NPCs were nicely done the game has some funness and little moments of quick decision making which keeps you engaged. well done on both

  
Id say apply the same art updates for jump on the bed and monster jam or truck derby w/e its called lol . The gameplay was fine but I wish my truck was a little more niceer to look at lol , same with the kid on the bed. otherwise fine mechanics

would love to include Kick brawl for sure and Spree on [slagdock.com](http://slagdock.com)

comments.body:
Still WIP, and not sure if relevant to your purpose 😅 ...but thought maybe worth sharing... (any feedback is the most welcome 😊).

It's my first AI made game, based on an old idea I had for kids (but also grown ups) to learn typing on the keyboard (right now it only supports spanish and english layouts) inspired on The Matrix digital rain effect (on the settings menu you can upload a photo that will be used for the background while you play).

Tip: CTRL+Alt+Shift+G unlocks all levels
